gloss: to drive back; to send away

definitions.gloss: to drive back; to send away; to chase off
definitions.explanation: To force someone to leave or go back, often by refusing them entry or driving them away.

examples.japanese: セールスマンを{追|お}い{返|かえ}す。
{野良猫|のらねこ}を{追|お}い{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I chased the stray cat away.

examples.japanese: {門|もん}の{前|まえ}で{不審者|ふしんしゃ}を{追|お}い{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I drove a suspicious person away at the gate.

notes: A compound verb from {追|お}う (to chase) and {返|かえ}す (to return/send back). Implies forcefully making someone go back or leave. Transitive. Collocations: セールスマンを{追|お}い{返|かえ}す (turn away a salesman), {敵|てき}を{追|お}い{返|かえ}す (drive back the enemy).
